title: NFLPA names Laquon Treadwell their Community MVP for Week 7

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFLPA names Laquon Treadwell their Community MVP for Week 7
sources.description: The NFL Players Association announced on Friday that Colts wide receiver Laquon Treadwell has been named their Community MVP for Week 7 of the 2026 season.
